external_dependencies.ada.command_line: OS argument strings/counts and Ada Value parsing/failure behavior remain unproved; modeled observations cover typed normal-return options and, where recognized, the restricted decimal grammar.
external_dependencies.ada.numerics.long_elementary_functions: Installed elementary-function specifications are trusted interfaces. Their implementations, analytic accuracy, rounding/error bounds and totality are not proved; Ghost acceptance predicates model checked normal returns.
external_dependencies.ada.text_io: Text_IO and its instantiated numeric formatting generics, buffering, physical stdout/file bytes, persistence and exceptions remain unproved. Ghost models cover nominal fields/layouts and input/output observations only.
external_dependencies.interfaces: Machine integer representation and runtime/compiler implementation of interface operations remain trusted; project arithmetic proofs concern Ada semantics, not generated machine-code verification.
external_dependencies.interfaces.c: C double conversion, foreign ABI, libm implementation, error behavior and platform representation remain trusted; the C erfc boundary is explicitly modeled but not proved.

global_unproved_obligations.numerical-backends: C erfc, Ada elementary-function implementations, ABI/representation, rounding accuracy and backend totality are unproved. Ghost predicates describe checked normal-return properties, not certified analytic functions or error bounds.
global_unproved_obligations.runtime-and-io: Ada runtime, argument retrieval/Value attributes, string/image/formatting generics, memory/resource failures, filesystem effects, permissions, buffering, physical bytes, and exception/failure semantics remain unproved. Ordinary SPARK request receipts and separately marked Ghost observations record requests and normal-return values, not operating-system success or full persistent output traces.
global_unproved_obligations.model-adequacy: An analyzed Ghost model does not prove that an excluded implementation refines it, that guards never reject, or that the model is a complete specification. Decimal recognition, lexical fields, bounded payload summaries and nominal layouts have stated restricted scopes; coupled calls in Off bodies are execution observations, not static refinement proofs.
global_unproved_obligations.psychometric-validity: No Ghost model establishes empirical test correlations, population calibration, Gaussian distributions, pseudo-random independence, extreme-tail frequencies, reliability interpretation or psychometric validity. These require separate mathematical/statistical and empirical justification.
global_unproved_obligations.toolchain-and-provers: Compiler/runtime translation, target floating representation, GNATprove/Why3/SMT solvers, operating system and hardware are trusted verification infrastructure; neither their implementations nor independent proof-object checking are proved by this campaign.

contracts.clause: (if Event in Simulation_Header_Event | Simulation_Row_Event then Column_Count'Result = 11)
(if Event in Calculations_Header_Event | Calculation_Row_Event | Infinite_Row_Event then Column_Count'Result = 4)
(if Event in No_Event | Options_Read | Examples_Header_Event then Column_Count'Result = 0)
(if Text'Length > 1 and then Text (Text'First) = '0' then not Decimal_Image'Result)
(if Lower_SF >= P and then Upper_SF <= P then Inverse_Bracket_Acceptable'Result)
(if Numeric_Format'Result then Digits_After = 12 or else Digits_After = 14)

(if U in 2.0 ** (-53) .. 1.0 - 2.0 ** (-53)
      and then Radius in 0.0 .. 9.0 then Radius_Acceptable'Result)
(Simulation_Payload'Result => (N, Trials, Mean, Variance, C, Rate_Two, Rate_Three, Expected_Two, Expected_Three))
(if Sqrt_Acceptable'Result then (if X <= 1.0 then Value <= 1.0) and then (if X >= 1.0E-6 then Value >= 0.0005))

(if Value >= 0.0
      and then (if X <= 1.0 then Value <= 1.0)
      and then (if X >= 1.0E-6 then Value >= 0.0005) then Sqrt_Acceptable'Result)

Transition'Result.Section =
         (case Event is
            when Simulation_Header_Event => Simulation,
            when Calculations_Header_Event => Calculations,
            when Examples_Header_Event => Examples,
            when others => Trace.Section)
(if Valid_Column_Label'Result then (for all C of Label => C /= ',' and then C /= ASCII.LF and then C /= ASCII.CR))
(if Label'Length > 0 and then (for all C of Label => C /= ',' and then C /= ASCII.LF and then C /= ASCII.CR) then Valid_Column_Label'Result)
C.Above_Rare = C.Above_Rare'Old + (if Z > Rare_Cutoff then 1 else 0)
(if Valid'Result then C.Above_Three <= C.Above_Two and then C.Above_Two <= C.Total)
(if C.Above_Rare <= C.Above_Three and then C.Above_Three <= C.Above_Two and then C.Above_Two <= C.Total then Valid'Result)
((Report_Output, Trace) => (N, Factor, Z, Score, Report_Output, Trace))

Trace = Hoeflin_Boundary_Models.Transition (Trace'Old, Hoeflin_Boundary_Models.Simulation_Row_Event, Hoeflin_Boundary_Models.Simulation_Payload (N, Trials, Mean, Variance, C, Rate_Two, Rate_Three, Expected_Two, Expected_Three))
((Report_Output, Trace) => (N, Trials, Mean, Variance, C, Rate_Two, Rate_Three, Expected_Two, Expected_Three, Report_Output, Trace))
